assessments.support: The 539 subjects with ASD and the 573 controls were split 70/15/15 into training, validation and test sets. No explicit motion/QC exclusion rule beyond using the ABIDE-preprocessed release is described in this paper.

ASD/control labels are the underlying ABIDE site diagnoses; no additional diagnostic criterion described in this paper.

10-fold cross-validation is used and a separate held-out test split is described (70/15/15), but no site covariate, harmonisation or leave-one-site-out evaluation is reported, and the training accuracy was "well above 90%, indicating overfitting" (the training accuracy is well above 90%, indicating over ﬁtting), which raises concern about the reliability of the reported test accuracies.

risk_of_bias.summary: Full ABIDE I cohort (539 ASD/573 controls) and pipeline (CCS, ReHo) clearly reported, but no explicit participant-level QC/motion rule, no site handling, and the authors themselves note overfitting in the 3D CNN.

charting.title: Evaluation of Augmentation Methods in Classifying Autism Spectrum Disorders from fMRI Data with 3D Convolutional Neural Networks
charting.primary_goal: Evaluate how different data-augmentation strategies affect 3D-CNN test accuracy for classifying ASD vs controls from ABIDE resting-state fMRI ReHo derivatives.
charting.study_setting: Multi-site (ABIDE I, 17 sites per the full release)
charting.specific_features: ReHo derivative volumes (no ROI atlas; voxel-wise 3D CNN input)
charting.feature_extraction_tools: CCS (Connectome Computation System) via ABIDE preprocessed
charting.specific_algorithms: 3D CNN (3 convolutional layers + dense layer + sigmoid output) trained with various data-augmentation strategies (scaling, rotation, brightness, elastic deformation)
charting.validation_methodology: 70/15/15 train/validation/test split, 10-fold cross-validation for mean test accuracy
charting.performance_metrics: Test accuracy (10-fold CV mean and SD)
charting.key_performance_results: Compared to no augmentation, the best augmentation approach increases the test accuracy by 0.6 percentage units. elastic deformations seem to work best, with an improvement of 2.2 percentage units.
charting.summary_key_findings: Data augmentation provided only minor improvements in 3D-CNN test accuracy for ASD-vs-control classification on ABIDE ReHo data (0.6-2.2 percentage points depending on strategy and stopping criterion); about half of the augmentation strategies tested reduced test accuracy relative to no augmentation, and training accuracy well above 90% indicated overfitting.
charting.future_directions_recommended: Evaluate other ABIDE-preprocessed derivatives and multi-channel 3D CNNs combining several derivatives.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Diagnostic prediction; ABIDE I (ABIDE preprocessed), 539 ASD / 573 controls (1112 total)
narrative_row.methods: CCS-pipeline ReHo derivative volumes (voxel-wise, no atlas) fed into a 3D CNN; 70/15/15 train/val/test split with early stopping and 10-fold cross-validation; multiple data-augmentation strategies (scaling, rotation, brightness, elastic deformation) compared.
narrative_row.outcomes: Augmentation gave only minor test-accuracy improvements (0.6-2.2 percentage points depending on strategy/stopping rule); about half of augmentation strategies reduced accuracy; training accuracy >90% indicated overfitting.
narrative_row.key_limitations: No explicit motion/QC rule, no site handling, and authors note overfitting; absolute baseline accuracy values not stated numerically in text (only relative percentage-point changes and figures).
narrative_row.relevance_notes: Uses the full ABIDE-I ABIDE-preprocessed release (CCS pipeline, ReHo) as a methodological testbed for augmentation rather than proposing a novel classifier; illustrates a predictive study with weak leakage/site-handling reporting.
